notes.title: 🛠️ Brooks in Wild West — New Extra Update Now Available! 🤠
notes.notes:
Howdy, cowboys and cowgirls!

We’ve got some fresh news for Brooks in Wild West!
After the release of version 1.0, I found a few bugs that needed fixing. But instead of just pushing out a simple hotfix, I decided to take this opportunity to add even more content for you to enjoy.

✅ Here’s what’s included in this extra update:

🔹 New route variants in Chapter 5 — more choices, more paths!
🔹 9 new NSFW scenes added to the gallery.
🔹 New ending variant — now you can choose to either return to your own time or stay in the Wild West.
🔹 Bug fixes in Chapter 4 that were blocking story progression.
🔹 Rebecca will now be at the railway station every Saturday with her repeatable scenes available.
🔹 2 new repeatable interactions with Ivana at the ranch.
🔹 Hidden Easter eggs — explore carefully!

🛠️ General fixes:
Several bugs from version 1.0 have been resolved to ensure smoother and more stable gameplay.

🚀 What’s next?
This is just the first of several extra updates planned!
If you’d like to see exclusive scenes with a specific character, feel free to leave a comment in the community — I’ll be taking your suggestions into account for future updates.

Enjoy the new content, and thanks again for all your support!
See you in the Wild West. 🤠
